subject.title: Bug: isRecurringTopOfHourCronExpr fails to match cron expressions with step values

question: Should maintainers adopt the open cross-repo fix path, replace it with a target-repo PR, or close that candidate before allowing a new repair lane?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but an open unmerged and non-maintainer-editable PR already claims the fix, so automation should not create another fix lane until maintainers choose the handling path.

options.title: Adopt or replace the linked fix
options.body: Review the open cross-repo PR and either land it through a maintainer-controlled branch or open a narrow replacement with equivalent credit and proof.

options.title: Wait for the PR author
options.body: Leave the issue paired to the cross-repo PR and ask the author to make a maintainable target-repo PR with real behavior proof.

options.title: Close the linked candidate first
options.body: Close the cross-repo candidate as non-actionable or stale before allowing a new ClawSweeper repair lane.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the linked fix
recommendation.body: Review the open cross-repo PR and either land it through a maintainer-controlled branch or open a narrow replacement with equivalent credit and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the default stagger behavior and is the clearest history-backed owner for deciding how to carry the fix path forward.
